comment: Squad comms audio spec, read by tools/comms_pipeline.py. Human lines in the shipped bank are Kokoro-82M voices re-voiced by Chatterbox (2026-11-12, provenance in web/audio/comms/manifest.json); new renders come from the voice-stack engines (VoxCPM2 speech, Dia non-verbals) through the host studio. Demon lines are performances reversed and pitched down plus synthesized grunts. All go through the radio chain, are loudness-normalised and encoded to web/audio/comms/<clip id>.ogg (Opus) and .m4a (AAC-LC).

identity.comment: Reference sentence each character speaks for their identity clip (refs stage; openspec/changes/voice-stack design §4). Chatterbox, which cloned these clips for the 2026-11-12 bank, was dropped (operator, 2026-11-16): VoxCPM2 renders speech and placeholders, Dia the non-verbals, as admitted studio nodes.
identity.reference_text: Radio check on the fleet channel. I read you loud and clear, and the weather over the frontier is quiet tonight. Stand by for further orders, and keep this line open.

delivery.comment: Engine-independent delivery shaping per emotion, applied to human takes in the radio stage (deliver()): expand widens intonation, shift moves pitch in semitones, tempo stretches, dynamics widens loudness contour.

gibberish.comment: Nonsense syllables rendered by Kokoro from phonemes (never English words), then granulated and pitch/formant shifted under the growl layer.

radio.comment: v3 softer keying: levels are relative to the voice peak (1.0) before loudness normalisation. Click = rounded sine 'tock'; burst/tail = low-passed carrier noise (RMS-scaled); tone = quiet fleet key-up tone.

grunt_lengths.comment: raw_max_s caps the synthesized grunt; min_s/max_s bound the final clip (with keying lead and tail). Unlisted triggers: 0.5-1.9 s.
